text:
Predicates:
CityIn(x, y) ::: x is a city in y.
SameState(x, y) ::: x and y are in the same state.
Premises:
CityIn(billings, montana) ::: Billings is a city in Montana.
CityIn(butte, montana) ∧ CityIn(helena, montana) ∧ CityIn(missoula, montana) ::: Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
SameState(whiteSulphurSprings, butte) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in the same state.
¬CityIn(pierre, montana) ::: The city of Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x (CityIn(x, butte) → ¬CityIn(x, pierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in Pierre.
Conclusion:
CityIn(missoula, montana) ::: Montana is home to the city of Missoula.
